<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Get remaining green blocks and their centers

print(f"Remaining green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Calculate center of each block from boundary
targets = []
for n in green_nodes:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    targets.append((center_row, center_col))
    print(f"  Block at boundary {boundary} -> center ({center_row}, {center_col})")

# Batch click all remaining green blocks
mouse_actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in targets]
print(f"\nExecuting {len(mouse_actions)} MOUSE clicks...")
result = action(mouse_actions)
print(f"Result: level={result.get('level')}, score={result.get('score')}, done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check remaining green blocks
